title.narrative: IDMC - Enhancing prevention, risk reduction and response to disaster and climate-related displacement worldwide

description.narrative:
The overall objective/expected impact of the proposed action is to reduce the risk and impacts of disaster and climate-related displacement in pilot countries and regions through developmental actions. The project aims to achieve the following two specific objectives/outcomes:

  1. Understanding of the drivers, patterns, impacts, and future risks of internal displacement with a focus on disaster, environmental degradation and climate-related displacements is increased.
  2. The capacity of governments and regional organisations to monitor, report on, prevent, adapt to the consequences and resolve disaster displacement is strengthened.
